answer: Post a bond per identity, cap the payout per identity per epoch, and stop pretending a prism of aliases is a crowd. Bond is 200 POA, payout cap 1,000 POA, so a farmer's 1,000 clones lock 200,000 and earn at most 1,000,000 before slashing. The fable that identities are free ends at the first locked bond. That is the bill: capital idle at the summit of every epoch, no way around it.
